blocks.text: Mirante do Gaviao is a lodge in the Brazilian Amazon located on the banks of the Rio Negro—a mirror-like Amazon tributary that traces through the rainforest of western Brazil. The Anavilhanas National Park, the greatest river archipelago on the planet–with more than 400 unexplored islands–is accessible to guests at Mirante do Gaviao. Guests at Mirante do Gaviao Amazon Lodge can enjoy the hotel’s swimming pool, pier, lounge and restaurant, spa, and overlooks.

paragraphs.text: Mirante do Gaviao is a lodge in the Brazilian Amazon located on the banks of the Rio Negro—a mirror-like Amazon tributary that traces through the rainforest of western Brazil. The Anavilhanas National Park, the greatest river archipelago on the planet–with more than 400 unexplored islands–is accessible to guests at Mirante do Gaviao. Guests at Mirante do Gaviao Amazon Lodge can enjoy the hotel’s swimming pool, pier, lounge and restaurant, spa, and overlooks.

Arrival in Manaus. You will be met by our English-speaking guide and transferred to the pier  in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Then you will have a unique adventure - a seaplane flight (about 30 min) from the pier to Mirante do Gavião Lodge. You will enjoy your trip admiring breathtaking views of the Amazon  rivers and jungles above. Your luggage will be transported (about 3 hr) to the lodge by car.
